verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile documents global code search for locating code snippets and navigating repositories, and a community user reports browsing code on the phone, so the core search-and-navigate capability exists. However, the evidence never mentions fuzzy matching, search filters/qualifiers, or regular-expression support, which are the specific elements of this story. missing for 10: evidence of fuzzy matching, documented search filters/qualifiers, regular-expression search support, in-depth search docs, independent hands-on corroboration of code search quality

support.subject: As a developer, I can search and navigate code content using fuzzy matching, filters, and regular expressions

citations.quote: Effortlessly locate code snippets, navigate repositories, and access content directly from your home screen with global code search.
Really enjoyed using it to casually browse code on the phone
